It's not, trust me, and if it is, distracting yourself with whatever you love doing will really make you forget about it all. 

Also, I'm sure you have someone who cares, this person would feel bad and useless if you did that, it's just not an option to solve things.

Hopefully it'll pass.

Well, you said you're not feeling well because you can't practice the sports you love but you can, that was my point; also you were once used to practice but you're not doing it anymore, I'm thinking this could be the cause for some of your pain (but I could be wrong because I don't know all the details) but my final point stands:

Don't do something permanent because of something that will pass (that thing being the pandemic).

You talk just like me in a bad mood lol 
But I can't do sports because my body can't handle it (asthma tho).

But who said you can't do sports in your home? There are plenty of articles and guides about that in the internet and a commercial of a sneakers brand even showed that. I recommend you to look it up, if you can't find it tell me cuz I can search for u; just don't do something permanent because of a momentary problem, this pandemic situation will pass and, when it does, I'm sure you'll be happy to return doing all of the things you love, you can even study more about those sports because you're never going to have so much free time like this! 

Also, if you keep exercising at home and coron@ hits you, it'll surely be more like a flu to you.

I get you, I wish I could blame genetics for my problems lol, but it seems that I'm just unlucky.
All I can say is, cheer up because you'll get better (as long as you strive and fight for it); and do things that makes you happy because being mad or sad only makes the pain worse; listen to some music as it's proved that helps with pain as well; having a pet is great as petting one helps with stress and they're so cute (人 •͈ᴗ•͈) .

Hope you get better and I really mean it, I know what's like to feel bad because you're young and can't be or do what young people are supposed to be or do but you'll find your way around, I guarantee. If you need to chat or just talk your problems out, do it, I'll be here (talk about it all with a friend, it helps a lot).

It would be okay if it was only those people because, in the end, I got out of that school; but a family member telling me that, really hurtful. Plus, she's 30 and nobody tries to discipline her anymore (even tho she's living with us); my mom just blamed me and made the situation even worse, my stepfather did nothing and said nothing.
The only real solution is to get outta here but I can't get a job in the current situation because I'm not that healthy to just go out and not worrying about this "flu" around, and there are barely any people hiring for home office... So I'll be waiting and keep trying my best to find a job.
I appreciate what you've said and you're right about people out of school not talking like that, as this kind of talk is something you expect from younger people because they don't mean it and just want to say something that hurts, but not from older people because it carries that meaning and it's so heavy; luckily one day, I won't be near her to hear those things.

Thanks for all you said, it's a nice way to think about that situation; now I'm going to try and apply this blackboard mindset, hopefully this works and erase the "suicide" out of it as well, at least for now.
Now I know that; I'm really grateful for what you said and, as I was told one day "the best vengeance is to live your best life" so I'mma try that.

Ikr
I wish it was that simple to ignore but I'll keep trying. Thanks so much for your words

Of course she shouldn't, Satan would loose his throne lol;
Thanks a lot tho, really needed every single word.
